Dev Patel: Heads up: Customer Success + Support are kicking off the **Known-Issues Sprint** this week (2-week sprint + adoption cleanup). Goal is to get the top repeat pain points into copy/paste-ready KB articles + link them from Support workflows.

If your team is hearing the same customer issue more than once (or you see it coming up in onboarding/QBRs), please route it to **#support** with:
• symptom + endpoint (chat/embeddings/rerank/etc)
• region + tier (Hosted/Dedicated/Private)
• model + SDK version (if known)
• any request IDs / rough timestamps

We’ll triage + either add it to the sprint backlog or point to an existing workaround.
KB hub (internal): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/x/known-issues-index
Working intake list (internal): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/known-issues-sprint-triage

Please avoid posting customer-identifying details in public channels—DM #support or use the SUP ticket flow if needed. :pray:

(reactions: :thumbsup: from Sean Gallagher, :eyes: from Elliot Price, :white_check_mark: from Talia Benson)

Elliot Price: +1 — if you already have “tribal knowledge” steps you’ve been sharing in DMs (timeouts, retry settings, headers, installer flags, etc), drop them in #support and we’ll turn them into a clean KB format. Keeping everything customer-safe + searchable.

Talia Benson: For intake, we’re using a quick template in #support (pinned). If you paste in there, it’s easiest for us to convert into an article / macro.

Sean Gallagher: Also: if you think it’s incident-level (multi-customer or sustained error rate), please still follow the normal path (bridge -> #incidents). Known-issues sprint is for “workarounds + faster triage,” not bypassing on-call.

Priya Natarajan: Platform folks are in the review loop for anything quota/auth/SSO/audit logs/routing. If you see repeat issues around those areas, flag it — we can validate mitigations and update runbooks/docs.

Rachel Kim: CS ask: please include **impact framing** when you can (blocked vs degraded, # of users, business critical workflows). Helps us decide if it’s a KB workaround vs an escalation + comms.

Chris Osei: If you have screenshots/UX notes for places customers get confused (esp Console dashboards / error messages), send them too. We can tie doc fixes to small product changes where it reduces ticket volume.

Wei Chen: For folks writing up steps: try to keep it as “Symptoms / Likely cause / Workaround / When to escalate.” We’ll handle the polishing.

Naomi Feldman: Reminder: don’t paste raw customer logs with secrets/tokens into general. If you need Security eyes on something, route via #support and tag me.

Avery Johnson: Quick Q from Sales side — should we send “repeat questions” from prospects too, or only active customers?

Dev Patel: Prospects are welcome *if* it’s clearly about how the product behaves (not pricing/contract). Just label it “prospect” and keep it generic. If it’s account-specific, route through the normal AE/CS channel and we’ll pull what we can into docs.

Slackbot: Pinned an item to this channel: “Known-Issues Sprint KB hub (internal link)”
